decisions.statement: A reminder names the times for sending as systemd states a calendar.
Systemd is asked when the next sending falls rather than a parser here.
A reminder first seen is armed rather than sent.
A reminder whose sending was missed while nothing ran is caught up rather than dropped.
A reminder naming one time is taken away once that reminder has sent.
When a reminder next falls due is held outside the commit.
A reminder says nothing about how the words reach the persona named.

definition: words sent to somebody at the times the words name
